objective: Replace AJ landing-by-materialization as the primary certificate with a parent-only signed-incidence upper certificate for the exact-DP child class, then independently verify against exact DP. Either certify a self-preserving pivot on each frozen reachable residual or preserve the first explicit reachable witness/gap.
frozen_domain: Same 15-root AH/AI/AJ domain and truth-blind generation; no new family added after outcomes.
selector: Variables only, sorted by AJ local RAW_S_UB then variable id; no SAT truth and no subset search.

parent_only_child_bound.description: For each candidate pivot x, bound each surviving variable's positive/negative child occurrence counts and width sums from parent co-incidences with x, ignoring tautology/dedup/subsumption gains. Drop the negative -a_y*b_y term when upper-bounding child P_hat. Use RAW_S_UB(x) as child S upper bound and V-1 as child variable upper bound.
parent_only_child_bound.certificate: A candidate is symbolically self-preserving only if the resulting parent-only upper bound implies the AI signed-incidence class inequality for the exact-DP child before cheap replay.
parent_only_child_bound.independent_verifier: Materialize exact DP only after symbolic selection; require replay pass and require actual child signed-incidence class membership or terminal after cheap replay.

result_policy: Do not weaken the parent-only bound after seeing outcomes. A symbolic certificate gap is not a CNF counterexample if exact landing still preserves the class.
